capture.method: read from the plain-JS chunks split on '// @bun @bytecode' (1657 chunks via ~/.claude/oracle-chunks/extract.py), NOT from claude-code/src, which is a stale mirror
capture.note: Each entry names the function or offset it came from. A count or a substring hit is never the evidence here — a bundled name, for example, is only a name when a registration says so.

gate_defaults.comment: These carry the campaign's 'not a gap' rulings. If one flips upstream, the matching classification in accepted_divergences.json becomes wrong and nothing else would notice.

tengu_mcp_legacy_sse_fallback.meaning: the legacy HTTP+SSE rescue is LIVE upstream

tengu_surface_failed_mcp_servers.meaning: failed MCP servers surface in the ToolSearch note

tengu_lively_waffle.meaning: SubagentHandback is DORMANT upstream; absence here is alignment

tengu_keybinding_customization_release.meaning: keybindings-help is live upstream and genuinely missing here

mcp_policy.exemption_rule: F6: deny first (Pme), then scope-exempt AND NOT expandedFromEnv AND NOT pluginSource, then the allowlist
mcp_policy.expanded_from_env_from: Fxo(entry) on the RAW entry: stdio command/args/env values, sse|http|ws url/header values, nothing for sse-ide|ws-ide|sdk|claudeai-proxy

managed_settings_key.name: managedMcpServers
managed_settings_key.shape_error: "managedMcpServers" must be an object keyed by server name (the .mcp.json mcpServers shape; Claude Desktop's array form of its same-named key is not accepted here: use the server name as the key and "type" instead of "transport"). No managed MCP servers are installed from it until it is fixed.
managed_settings_key.name_error: server names may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, and may not be __proto__, constructor or prototype

legacy_sse_rescue.predicate_from: Hs(e): status in {400,404,405} AND the body does NOT parse as a JSON-RPC message (js(e) reads the `data:` line first)
legacy_sse_rescue.project_scope_refusal: Its url, command or args reference an environment variable; on connect Claude Code would expand it into a repo-authored command or url. Add it manually with `claude mcp add` if you trust this repo.

goal_cleared_reasons.comment: kB(goal, reason) call sites — the reason is an argument, never a constant

bundled_skills.comment: Read off registrations — literal uo({name:"…"}) or a resolved variable. NOT off substring counts: `stuck` has ~50 occurrences and no registration.

sse_transport.comment: The legacy HTTP+SSE contract this port did not implement before ff8bda8b4
sse_transport.endpoint_event: named `endpoint` event, resolved relative to the stream url
sse_transport.same_origin_error: Endpoint origin does not match connection origin:
